description: Swift catalog/API model types recovered from __swift5_types + __swift5_fieldmd of Metronaut.app frameworks (Networking, Core, Domain, RealmDataSource). Mangled type suffixes: Si=Int, SS=String, Sb=Bool, Sd=Double, Sf=Float, Su=UInt, Sg=Optional, Say..G=Array, SDy..G=Dictionary, <X>=resolved local type, <?>=type from another module (unresolved). codingKeys attached heuristically (nearest following CodingKeys enum whose cases are a subset of the fields).
